description: Run any WaveSpeed model. input keys come from get_model_schema; unknown keys are rejected before submission. Local files: pass "@./path" in a media field (image, images, video, audio, mask …) — it is uploaded and replaced with hosted URLs (bare paths are NOT uploaded). Returns the prediction id right away (done=false); call get_prediction with that id and wait_seconds until done=true to get the output URLs. The task keeps running on the server. Pass wait_seconds here to wait for a quick model in the same call.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

name: run_model
